description: AllRatesToday's once-a-day, never-revised mid-market rate: the per-currency median of samples in a five-minute window centred on 16:00 London, published each business day. Use it when the user needs ONE reproducible rate per day — index levels, return series, research datasets, month-end reports — rather than a live quote (get_exchange_rate) or an institution's official rate (get_official_rates). Omit source/target for the whole table; give both for one pair (crossed via USD, flagged `derived`). Omit `date` for the latest table (no key needed); give `date` (API key, paid plan) for a past business day. Not the WM/Refinitiv fix and not a registered benchmark — relay the disclaimer and the `rate_date`.

date.description: Optional past business day, YYYY-MM-DD (API key, paid plan). Omit for the latest table.

source.description: Optional. With target, narrows to one pair.

target.description: Optional. With source, narrows to one pair.

name: get_reference_rate

rate_date.description: Business day the table was fixed on — cite this
